description:
A CAD application built with Rust — 2D/3D drawing, DWG/DXF support, and GPU-accelerated rendering.


OpenCADStudio - Release v2026.47 (2026-11-22)
> Summary: Added the contextual Text Editor ribbon tab with paragraph formatting and background mask controls, the POPMENU custom cursor menu, ADDVERTEX and DELVERTEX polyline vertex editing, PanelStyle::Form plugin panels, localized command-line command names, annotation scale prompting for dimensions/multileaders/blocks, smooth curve export for hatch boundary arcs in PDF/SVG plots, and fixes across Text Style Apply/Discard, TrueType glyph widths, DGN V8/WMF/3DS/PDF readers, undo granularity, and WASM linking.
🌟 Notable Release Notes
- Text Editor Ribbon Tab: Editing multiline text opens a contextual Text Editor ribbon tab and companion windows, supporting measured paragraph units, lettered lists, Combine Paragraphs, background mask selection (defaulting to red when unmasked), and translated line-spacing shortcuts (#3095). (Contributed by @ramox81 and @HakanSeven12)
- POPMENU Custom Cursor Menu: Displays the user's own configured commands in a menu right at the cursor (#3066). (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- ADDVERTEX and DELVERTEX: Adds and removes polyline vertices interactively by picking. (Contributed by @HakanSeven12)
- Plugin Form Panels (PanelStyle::Form): Allows plugin panels to choose a structured form layout alongside Palette via the shared FormControlView (#3092). (Contributed by @yztink)
🚀 New Features
- Localized Command Names: Accepts localized command names typed directly at the command line (#3077). (@HakanSeven12)
- Annotation Scale Question: Prompts for annotation scale before creating annotative dimensions, multileaders and block references (#3090). (@ramox81)
- PDF and SVG Hatch Boundary Curves: Plots hatch boundary arcs as smooth curves rather than faceted chords in PDF and SVG exports (#3076). (@HakanSeven12)
- Centered Ribbon & Wheel Tab Switching: The ribbon's right-click menu and Options › Window Elements can center the tabs and panels on wide screens (off by default), and turning the mouse wheel or swiping sideways over the ribbon steps through its tabs (on by default; ignored while a dropdown, the ribbon menu or search results are open, or with a modifier key held). The command search box now collapses to its magnifier exactly when the tab row could no longer hold it beside the Quick Access Toolbar and the tabs, before those wrap onto two rows, rather than below a fixed window width.
- CIRCLE Tangent Snaps & MASSPROP Prompt: CIRCLE 2P and 3P accept Tangent object snaps; MASSPROP prompts for objects when nothing is selected. (@HakanSeven12)
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Text, Styles & Fonts: Text Style Apply preserves the values existing texts store (#3089) and Discard no longer requires a mutable stage; TEXT and attributes draw with their own oblique angle including 0; _MTED matches as a whole word only in Text Editor tools; the Missing Fonts window can be turned off and back on. (@ramox81 and @HakanSeven12)
- Modify, Layers & Naming: COPY preserves the original objects' drawing order; RENAME keeps names with spaces whole whether typed quoted or answered step by step (#3083); each LAYER option commits as a single undo step (#3080). (@KarimJerbi, @assamaral, @travisjhughes and @HakanSeven12)
- PDF, DGN, WMF & 3DS Interchange: PDF export embeds TrueType faces with their real glyph widths; PDF reader skips path segments that have no current point (#3085); DGN V8 reads level names from every non-model stream and UTF-16 string linkages; WMF import skips records claiming more points than they hold (#3071); 3D Studio import bounds chunk lengths safely without 32-bit overflow. (@HakanSeven12 and @travisjhughes)
- Web, CI & Regression Tests: Kept proj4wkt native-only so the WASM web app links cleanly; added regression suites for PDF import (#3087), Windows metafile import (#3081), 3D Studio import (#3075), a 31-command undo sweep (#3079), RENAME quoted names, hatch panel cached fill rebuilds, and group save/reload persistence; fixed UTC release code-health measurement (#3073) and wiki CI error reporting (#3074). (@HakanSeven12, @travisjhughes, @KarimJerbi and @assamaral)
⚡ Performance
- Selection Preview at Scale: Rollover and marquee (SELECTIONPREVIEW) highlight updates no longer rebuild the committed selection's GPU overlay: hover changes ride a separate hover generation, so previewing a selection box over a drawing with thousands of objects already selected stays smooth. Selectable-group expansion reads a cached group snapshot instead of scanning every document object on every pointer move, marquee tick and rendered frame; the per-frame viewport selection data is cached per selection generation; dense-entity highlights reuse a persistent overlay constant buffer with partial updates instead of cloning the whole scene's constants; hovered text highlights are cached per hover identity; a marquee over SELECTIONPREVIEWLIMIT now caps the preview (stable subset) instead of dropping it entirely; and committing a huge selection defers the Properties panel rebuild by one frame so the click or box release returns instantly. (@emrahoksak)
👥 Contributors

- Travis Hughes (@travisjhughes) — undo sweep across 31 commands (#3079), LAYER undo steps (#3080), PDF/WMF/3DS import tests and safety fixes (#3071, #3075, #3081, #3085, #3087), CI health and wiki fixes (#3073, #3074).
- Hakan Seven (@HakanSeven12) — POPMENU (#3066), ADDVERTEX/DELVERTEX, localized command names (#3077), hatch boundary curve plotting (#3076), TrueType PDF glyph widths, DGN V8 UTF-16 linkages, CIRCLE tangent snaps, MASSPROP prompt, WASM build fix and PR reviews.
- yztink (@yztink) — PanelStyle::Form layout via FormControlView (#3092).
- Karim Jerbi (@KarimJerbi) — COPY drawing-order preservation and hatch/group regression tests.
- assamaral (@assamaral) — RENAME quoted names with spaces and tests (#3083).
